content:
“Use the US Government Supply Requisition Holotape at a radio tower.”

**Request Government Air Drop** is a repeatable quest in *Fallout 76*.

## Quick Walkthrough[edit]

## Detailed Walkthrough[edit]

This quest is automatically started after looting a U.S. Government supply requisition holotape. Take the holotape to any relay tower and load it into an emergency broadcast terminal, then confirm the request for an airdrop. The holotape will be consumed, a Government Aid Drop will be summoned, Secure Transport Container dropped, and the quest will conclude.

## Quest Stages[edit]

| Quest Stages | 
|---|
| Stage | Status | Description | Log Entry | 
| 1 | | Fix Relay Tower Terminal | US Government Supply Requisition Holotapes have one-use codes that allow the request of a supply drop from any operational radio relay. But I need to repair the relay tower terminal in order to do that. | 
| 2 | | Upload US Government Supply Requisition Holotape | | 
| 3 | ![Quest finished Quest finished](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/a/a9/FO76_icon_xpd_yellowcheck.png/15px-FO76_icon_xpd_yellowcheck.png) | Get the Supply Drop | | 

- Requesting a supply drop from a radio tower in a higher level region of the map will tend to provide more valuable supplies.
- Currently, all the Government Aid Drop bugs known to have existed have been fixed.
